We need
\[
ab(a-1)(b-1)=4800.
\]
Group as
\[
[a(a-1)][b(b-1)]=4800.
\]
Now \(a(a-1)\) and \(b(b-1)\) must be factors of \(4800\) of the form \(n(n-1)\). Testing such factors gives the only nontrivial matching pair:
\[
a(a-1)=20,\qquad b(b-1)=240,
\]
so \(a=5\) and \(b=16\), or vice versa. Therefore
\[
a+b=5+16=21.
\]

\[
\boxed{21}
\]
